summary: Kestra is an event-driven automation platform designed to schedule, execute, and monitor workflows defined in code. It provides a centralised system to coordinate complex data pipelines and operational tasks, such as ETL and ELT processes, across different programming languages.
goodFor: It suits technical teams that need to manage programmatic workflows and data pipelines using code-based configurations within an event-driven architecture.
watchOut: Adopting a new workflow orchestrator introduces a learning curve for defining processes in its specific syntax, and it will overlap heavily with established orchestration alternatives you might already run.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for state storage, provision an external database, and set up a reverse proxy with TLS termination for secure access.
